rationale: F65 is the foundational credit/metering layer referenced by ADR-0007 (subscriptions) and ADR-0009 (auto-claim). It introduces credit_balances + credit_transactions tables, CreditService, API endpoints, and frontend widgets. Risk: low — new tables, new router, existing auth system supports credit fields. No external payment integration. ADR-0007 and ADR-0009 are PROPOSED/DEFERRED and depend on this. Proceed with create-feature pipeline.
